articles.summary: What does it take to ignite a student’s interest in semiconductor manufacturing and technology careers? Sometimes, it begins with a cookie. Through the P-TECH manufacturing pathway, SkyWater introduces students to semiconductor manufacturing with a cookie. Frosting becomes deposited material. Polishing smooths the surface. articles.title: From Cookies to Careers: Building Semiconductor Career Pathways Through P-Tech
